div.div: 4 افاظهُ He (God) caused him to die. (K, TA.) And you say also, ضَرَبْتُهُ حَتَّى أَفَظْتُ نَفْسَهُ [I beat him, or smote him, until I made his soul to depart, or go forth]. (S.) And لَأُفِيظَنَّ نَفْسَكَ [I will assuredly cause thy soul to depart, or go forth] (M.) And افاظهُ ٱللّٰهُ نَفْسَهُ [God caused him to vomit forth his soul]. (Ks, T, S, M.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
